verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration RESTful API, and the kcadm.sh Admin CLI performs the same realm, user, role and client operations over it. It also documents public OIDC endpoints (well-known discovery, dynamic client registration, introspection, revocation, device grant), client-credentials service accounts for machine access, SCIM endpoints, the Authorization Protection API and health endpoints. One hands-on report says the admin API is inconsistent: some GETs return incomplete payloads and some endpoints don't save on POST, which makes idempotent automation hard. That is a quality caveat, not a contradiction of the documented capability. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), in-pack detail of the Admin API reference itself, and consistent admin API behavior per hands-on reports.
